decisions.reason: Identifies plugin A's unconditional useSessionPendingInteraction call throwing at render, the alpha.2 kit dropping that prop in favor of useSessionStatus with useSessions retained, and B using no standard-kit hooks and never throwing.

Explains one shared DrawerErrorBoundary over the whole dock list whose null fallback unmounts every entry (quoting the console 'unmounted entries' line) and the button surviving in the separate input.left slot under its own boundary.

Treats the disable test as proving A caused the unmount and B renders once freed, denies it certifies B's overall alpha.2 compatibility or A as the only defect, explains reinstalling B could not help, and refutes the colleague theory since B reads no kit hooks.

Code reads pending via useSessionStatus(...)?.pendingInteraction, probes seats before calling, falls back to stable unknown/empty values so only the attention badge degrades, and argues degradation must be silent because a throw nulls co-tenants' shared boundary subtree.

Refresh-only verification with no host restart, both entries coexisting under one boundary, and a B regression (paste/remove/multi-paste lifecycle) exercised with A enabled; hygiene covers defensive prop treatment, a tenant-local boundary, and host per-entry boundaries with explicit trade-offs.

caps.reason: The affirmative fix targets plugin A only; the A2-01 second-break discussion of B is an explicitly hedged open lead, not a claimed independent bug requiring a parallel fix.
